display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
pc reg, 9 bits
rst → 0
pc_en → pc_jmp ? operand :
pc_back ? pc − operand :
pc + 1 + pc_skip

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
rc reg, 5 bits
rst → 0
pc_en & REPEAT → rc_next
rc_next = rc == 0 ? delay : rc − 1
(REPEAT's delay bits are count − 1;
pc_back = REPEAT & rc_next != 0)

div.style: display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
imem ROM
N × 16 bits
word = imem[pc]

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
decode
opcode = word[15:13]
delay = word[12:8]
operand = word[7:0]
side = operand[7]
side_pin = operand[6:5]
side_val = operand[4]
own = operand[3:0]

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
tx_fifo
8 bits × depth
tx_push → append
pull_en → drop head

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
shift_dir reg, 1 bit
rst → 0 (LSB first)
cfg_en & field == 0 → own[0]

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
shift_reg reg, 8 bits
rst → 0
pull_en → fifo_head
shift_en → shift_dir ?
{shift_reg[6:0], 1'b0} : {1'b0, shift_reg[7:1]}
shift_bit = shift_dir ?
shift_reg[7] : shift_reg[0]

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
open_drain reg, 4 bits
rst → 0 (push-pull)
cfg_en & field == 1 → [1:0] ← own[1:0]
cfg_en & field == 2 → [3:2] ← own[1:0]

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
gpio reg, 4 bits
rst → 4'b1111
shift_en → gpio[0] ← shift_bit
gpio_en → gpio[side_pin] ← side_val
(SHIFT_OUT's side pin is never 0:
the two ports never collide)
gpio_oe = ~(open_drain & gpio)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p:
in_shift_reg reg, 8 bits
rst → 0
shift_in_en → shift_dir ?
{in_shift_reg[6:0], in_bit} : {in_bit, in_shift_reg[7:1]}
in_bit = gpio_in[own[3:2]]
(sampled at the same edge
a side effect writes gpio;
WAIT compares it with own[0])
skip_bit = in_shift_reg[own[3:1]]
(SKIP compares it with own[0])

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
rx_fifo
8 bits × depth
push_en → append in_shift_reg
rx_pop → drop head
